page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.6xlarge is a compute-focused instance utilizing an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture using the KVM hypervisor, it provides 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores with two threads per core. The processor incorporates vector instruction support including AVX, AVX-512, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with hardware-assisted cryptographic AES instructions. Total system memory is 24.0 GB, establishing a strict 1:1 ratio of 1.0 GB RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage or GPU acceleration, connecting instead to remote block storage across an 8 Gbps baseline network interface.

Benchmark testing shows marked variation between single-thread and multi-thread capabilities. Single-core tests, such as Geekbench single-core and single-threaded stress-ng, place the instance in the lower 25 percent of tested systems. Multi-core execution demonstrates solid scaling, reaching average tier performance in Geekbench multi-core, Clang compilation, ray tracing, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth benchmarks maintain middle-tier throughput for large-block reads and writes, though PassMark memory scores sit in the bottom quartile. Static web serving achieves 13.45 GB/sec, while Redis operations reach 17.02 million operations per second.

The primary technical tradeoff of the ecs.ic5.6xlarge lies in its lean memory allocation paired with modest single-core throughput. Because memory capacity is limited to 1.0 GB per vCPU, memory-intensive applications face resource starvation if scaled horizontally across all available threads. The instance instead provides balanced efficiency for dense CPU-bound tasks with minimal per-thread memory requirements, such as distributed CI/CD build farms, parallel software compilation, static web delivery, and lightweight CPU-based model inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.6xlarge is a compute-focused instance featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. Configured with 24.0 GB of RAM, the server maintains an exact 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 1.0 GB per thread, operating without integrated GPUs or bundled local storage. Baseline network capacity provides 8 Gbps. In benchmark evaluations, multi-core throughput scales reliably into the average range across software compilation, ray tracing, and parallel compression, offset by lower-tier single-core performance. This architecture offers an effective hardware profile for workloads where parallel processing demand exceeds memory capacity requirements. It is practical for parallel code compilation, multi-threaded batch compute, static web hosting, and lightweight model inference.
